При неизвестном результате изменения све: If the outcome of a change is unknown, check the server state before retrying. Logs are refreshed manually with R/F5.
Деморежим не использует сеть, доступы и: Demo mode uses no network or credentials and does not write settings. Minimum terminal size is 80×24; Tab switches hidden panes.
